## Medium Stingray (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 N Medium animal (aquatic)  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision, scent, tremorsense 100 ft.; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 11, flat-footed 13 (+1 Dex, +3 natural)  
 **hp** 36 (4d8+4)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +5, **Will** +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** swim 30 ft.  
 **Melee** sting +5 (1d4+3 plus poison)  
 **Special Attacks** poison  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 13, **Con** 13, **Int** 1, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 2  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 16 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** Ability Focus (poison), Skill Focus (Perception)  
 **Skills** Perception +10, Stealth +5, Swim +10  

**Special Abilities**

 **Poison (Ex)** Sting—injury; *save* Fort DC 15; *frequency* 1/round for 4 rounds; *effect* 1 Str and paralysis 1d4+1 rds.; *cure* 1 save.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** warm aquatic  
 **Organization** solitary or school (2–5)  
 **Treasure** none
